courses.overview: 由身分生命週期、聯邦與權限模型連結兩個已編寫的相鄰專業；相似方法不表示性能數值、權限或介面可以直接沿用。
courses.overviewEn: Connect identity lifecycle, federation and authorization models to two authored neighboring domains; shared methods do not make metrics, permissions or interfaces interchangeable.

related.title: 多因素驗證系統
related.why: 可移植「身分證明」的邊界辨識、對照資料與證據方法；兩課都需要可追溯的身分與授權。
related.whyEn: Transfer boundary identification, controlled records and evidence methods from identity proofing; both require traceable identities/permissions.
related.transfer: 可移植「身分證明」的邊界辨識、對照資料與證據方法；兩課都需要可追溯的身分與授權。
related.transferEn: Transfer boundary identification, controlled records and evidence methods from identity proofing; both require traceable identities/permissions.
related.difference: 本課主要處理身分生命週期、聯邦與權限模型；「多因素驗證系統」主要處理驗證因子、抗網釣與安全復原，其驗收指標及信任／物理邊界需重定義。
related.differenceEn: This course emphasizes identity lifecycle, federation and authorization models; Multifactor authentication systems emphasizes authentication factors, phishing resistance and secure recovery. Redefine acceptance metrics and trust/physical boundaries.
practice: 並排畫出「身分與存取管理」與「多因素驗證系統」的資料／元件流程，圈出可共用及不可共用的邊界。
移植本課「角色模型」的對照方法至「Challenge 新鮮度」，重新指定輸入、單位與可觀測量。
重算兩課假想例，列出哪些參數無法直接沿用，並各寫一項拒絕與一項放行證據。
practiceEn: Draw Identity and access management and Multifactor authentication systems flows side by side and mark transferable/nontransferable boundaries.
Transfer the comparison method from role models to challenge freshness, redefining inputs, units and observations.
Recompute both hypothetical cases, identify parameters that cannot transfer and write one rejection/acceptance record per case.

related.title: 企業零信任網路
related.why: 可移植「身分證明」的邊界辨識、對照資料與證據方法；兩課都需要可追溯的身分與授權。
related.whyEn: Transfer boundary identification, controlled records and evidence methods from identity proofing; both require traceable identities/permissions.
related.transfer: 可移植「身分證明」的邊界辨識、對照資料與證據方法；兩課都需要可追溯的身分與授權。
related.transferEn: Transfer boundary identification, controlled records and evidence methods from identity proofing; both require traceable identities/permissions.
related.difference: 本課主要處理身分生命週期、聯邦與權限模型；「企業零信任網路」主要處理資源導向授權、政策決策與持續證據，其驗收指標及信任／物理邊界需重定義。
related.differenceEn: This course emphasizes identity lifecycle, federation and authorization models; Enterprise zero-trust networks emphasizes resource-centric authorization, policy decisions and continuous evidence. Redefine acceptance metrics and trust/physical boundaries.
practice: 並排畫出「身分與存取管理」與「企業零信任網路」的資料／元件流程，圈出可共用及不可共用的邊界。
移植本課「角色模型」的對照方法至「裝置證據」，重新指定輸入、單位與可觀測量。
重算兩課假想例，列出哪些參數無法直接沿用，並各寫一項拒絕與一項放行證據。
practiceEn: Draw Identity and access management and Enterprise zero-trust networks flows side by side and mark transferable/nontransferable boundaries.
Transfer the comparison method from role models to device evidence, redefining inputs, units and observations.
Recompute both hypothetical cases, identify parameters that cannot transfer and write one rejection/acceptance record per case.
